messages:
Maya: Hi team, wanted a short run-through of recurring incident patterns this quarter so we can lock down owners and timelines. Can we surface 3-4 high-frequency causes and pragmatic fixes?
Sam: I exported the PM tags and filtered for repeats. Top categories: kernel/driver regressions, cache pressure evictions, model-runtime OOMs, and flaky external auth.
Priya: From product side, customers care about consistency more than peak throughput. any mitigation that reduces variance is high priority.
Evan: Ops note: two kernel regressions happened after automated kernel bundle updates. both correlated with low-cache headroom during large batch requests.
Sam: Quick counts: kernel/driver (5 incidents), cache evictions (7 incidents), runtime OOMs (4 incidents), auth flaps (3 incidents).
Maya: Good. For each cause, we need: short description, last occurrence, proposed owner, mitigation timeline, and blocker list.
Priya: I'll own auth flaps investigation and raise a stability PR. estimate 2w for hotfix, 1mo for full config drift automation.
Evan: I'll take kernel/driver rollout policy and put together a safer rollout plan: pinned bundles + staged canaries + fast rollback. 3 week estimate.
Sam: For cache evictions, propose: add synthetic cache-pressure probe, tune eviction thresholds, and a temporary auto-scale policy during rollouts. Rachel in SRE has expressed interest to help. 10d estimate for probe + alerting.
Maya: Who can own model-runtime OOMs? sounds like infra + ML-eng cross-team.
Priya: I can coordinate with ML-eng. suggest a short-term mitigation: smaller default batch sizes per model and more aggressive memory telemetry. 2w for mitigation, 6w for allocator patch.
Evan: Ops action: implement soft rollback for kernel bundles and add preflight compatibility check. blockers: release-window coordination and a test harness.
Sam: Action list draft:
- Evan -> rollout policy + rollback automation (due 2027-05-18)
- Rachel -> cache probe + alert tuning (due 2027-05-05)
- Priya -> auth-flap root cause + PR (due 2027-05-10)
- Priya + ML-eng -> runtime OOM mitigation plan (due 2027-05-12)
- Sam -> compile synth doc + impact estimates (due 2027-04-30)
Maya: Add estimated impact for each item (monthly incidents prevented, SLO improvement). Sam can you add numbers?
Sam: Yes. I'll approximate using last quarter incident rates and attach conservative savings.
Priya: Can we schedule a recurring 30m monthly sync to review these items and look for new patterns? Call it "recurring-incidents-review".
Maya: Agreed. monthly cadence works. first meeting: 2027-05-20.
oncall-bot: New ticket created: PM-2027-051 ("Recurring incident synthesis - Apr"). Creator: Sam.
Evan: I'll put notes in PM-2027-051 and tag release infra + eng-leads for rollout coordination.
Sam: Also adding a short verification checklist for each remediation: what success looks like, how we measure it, and rollback criteria.
Maya: Great. Wrap up: owners above, timelines noted, monthly review scheduled. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
Priya: I'll start the auth logs triage tomorrow and paste findings into the ticket.
Evan: Starting rollout policy draft now. adding a canary gating check.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2027-05-18 for follow-up on EV/rollout action.
